dedup001Verdict.decision: CARRY AS NEW, capped at Medium, with prominent humanReviewFlag — NOT suppressed, NOT resurrected at High, NOT a regression of fixed M-01.
reasoning: Root-cause overlap is substantial. DEDUP-001's core premise ('every economically-critical quantity is denominated at the vault rate but realizable only at the Curve AMM rate') is literally ledger M-02 ('NAV-anchored minOut is execution-price-blind'), which is ACKNOWLEDGED. Its 'socialized shortfall onto last-out stakers' is ledger M-03 ('requested-not-received decrement -> last-withdrawer shortfall'), MERGED into M-02 and explicitly dismissed (clients owner-curated, decrement is documented protocol-owned yield). Its skim/buffer angle overlaps M-04 (false-positive: slippage shared strictly proportionally).

Decisively, the run-11 M-02-run11 finding record (medium/M-02-erc4626-vault-oracle-manipulation.json, line 29) ALREADY raised this exact angle via ECON-004: 'the deposit solvency invariant is share-terms not underlying-terms, leaving a gap at AMM discount' — and the whole finding was REJECTED false-positive because withdraw-side divergence 'requires AMM/vault price to decouple and stay decoupled — closed by arbitrage / prevented by the NG rate oracle,' and 'the PoC only passed via a mock AMM hard-coded to ignore vault price.' The rejection rationale generally warns the pipeline 'relied on PoCs whose mocks decoupled from real on-chain behaviour.' DEDUP-001's forge invariant_realizableSolvency / medusa property_realizableSolvency counterexamples are driven by a hard-coded 'AMM-discount' step — exactly that modeling concern.

BUT three things keep it from a clean suppression under Law 1: (a) DEDUP-001 frames the trigger as a NATURAL, sustained sUSDe depeg ('historically discounted several percent in stress'), NOT the atomic donation-manipulation that M-02-run11 rejected — a natural depeg is NOT 'closed by arbitrage within blocks' the way a manipulation is, so the premise is materially different from the rejected one. (b) M-02's acknowledgement bounds the accepted residual at slippageBps x tradeSize; DEDUP-001 claims the skim-de-buffering mechanism breaks that bound (28.5e18 / 48.5e18 shortfalls, realizable 0.912 < principal 0.950), and that specific bounded->unbounded escalation under a natural depeg was NOT analyzed in run-11. (c) It carries a STILL-FAILING Tier-3 invariant (forge + medusa), the highest-signal evidence class, and High-severity caution + Law-1 recall both forbid silently dropping it.

Therefore the single question the human must answer is: does DEDUP-001's realizableSolvency harness model a REALISTIC, sustained sUSDe AMM discount (in which case the skim-de-buffering shortfall is a genuine Medium that the bounded M-02 acknowledgement does not cover), or does it bake in a hard-coded mock decoupling that real arbitrage / the NG rate oracle would close (in which case it collapses into the already-rejected M-02-run11 false-positive and the bounded M-02 acknowledgement)? Per Law 1, that adjudication is surfaced rather than pre-empted.

Severity is capped at Medium and the High escalation is explicitly withheld: run-11's authoritative triage rejected the High framing of the same vault-vs-AMM gap, and M-02's bound stands unless the human confirms the skim-de-buffering break is realistic.

Not a regression of M-01 (fixed): M-01's root cause was duplicate-client injection in a caller-supplied list, structurally removed by story-041 (no caller list + aggregate-surplus ceiling). DEDUP-001 instead attacks the RATE at which that ceiling/solvency claim is denominated (vault vs AMM). Different rootCauseClass -> no fingerprint match to M-01 -> not a regression; the M-01 fix remains intact.
